हालांकि इस रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक अभी तक फिल्म की सटीक रिलीज डेट और प्लेटफॉर्म का आधिकारिक ऐलान होना बाकी है, लेकिन फैंस अभी से कयास लगा रहे हैं। 🍿

क्या आप इस धमाकेदार म्यूजिक कॉमेडी ड्रामा फिल्म को देखने के लिए बेताब हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Meesaya Murukku 2 OTT Release: When and where to watch Hiphop Tamizha Adhi’s music comedy drama online
ctx.summary:
Meesaya Murukku 2, starring Hiphop Tamizha Adhi in the lead role, was released in theatres on September 25, 2026. Directed by the music composer-turned-actor himself, the film is now set for its digital premiere. Here are the details about its OTT release, plot, cast, and crew. 
 When and where to watch Meesaya Murukku 2 
 Meesaya Murukku 2 is scheduled to premiere on SonyLIV on November 6, 2026, coinciding with Diwali. The film will be available in Tamil, with dubbed versions in Telugu, Malayalam, Kannada, and Hindi. 
 Here’s the update: 
   Official trailer and plot of Meesaya Murukku 2 
 Meesaya Murukku 2  follows three generations of a family striving to take the genre of Gaana music from the streets of North Chennai to the global stage. 
 The story begins with Gaana Das, a respected figure in the local music community, and his supportive partner, Lakshmi, who dream of bringing their street-rooted melodies into the mainstream music industry. However, their ambitions face a major setback as established industry players refuse to recognise their musical background. 
 The narrative then shifts to their son, Tiger Siva, who inherits his father’s passion but struggles with financial difficulties, personal compromises, and a changing musical landscape. Despite the fusion of traditional rhythms with Western influences, street musicians continue to face barriers to recognition.
